steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In June 2024, a guest on Equity Mates questioned whether Brainchip had a viable product, saying it made many promises but delivered almost zero revenue, while IBM already generated revenue from its own neuromorphic chip and Brainchip had about $30 million cash, making commercialisation against bigger rivals difficult.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: Lucas Goode - Xero, NextDC, Brainchip, Cettire + more

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?
Can it reinvest its profits productively?
Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In March 2026, a guest on Equity Mates highlighted Brainchip had 22 red flags and a market value around $3 billion despite having less revenue than a local cafe, and said red hot retail sentiment and an exciting narrative kept it risky to short.

episode.title: The Data Signals That Predict Winning (and Losing) Stocks with Dr. David Allen

views.text: In November 2023, Equity Mates noted Brainchip reported about $27,000 in quarterly cash receipts while its market capitalisation was about $344 million, and it was burning roughly $4 million a quarter with about $17 million cash, raising questions about what the market had priced in.

episode.title: Buy or Sell: 10 stocks with Adam Keily & Owen Rask
